**The longest‑running video‑game franchise is *The Oregon Trail*** – it has been around for more than 50 years (first released in 1971 and the latest version came out in 2021).

**Producer:** The original and continuing series was produced by the **Minnesota Educational Computing Consortium (MECC)**.  MECC developed, published, and distributed the game series from 1974 onward, and later the franchise was licensed to other publishers (Broderbund, The Learning Company, Gameloft, etc.), but the core production and maintenance of the franchise has always been handled by MECC.

> *“The Oregon Trail ... was designed to teach eighth‑grade schoolchildren… The game was … produced by the Minnesota Educational Computing Consortium (MECC) in 1974.”*   
> — Wikipedia, *The Oregon Trail (series)* (accessed 2026‑11‑06)

*(Citation: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Oregon_Trail_(series))*

So, the producer who has been behind the longest‑running video‑game franchise is **MECC**.
